Name: (CP) Strong Wood Chipper
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=3]It saves space and is superior to conventional wood chippers in terms of efficiency and working time.

[/size][size=3]A little bit so as not to seriously upset the balance of the game!
(The working time is slightly longer than that of a regular wood chipper, but the number of pieces of wood output is set slightly higher for that reason.)

In order to obtain the recipe, you must become friends with Robin and also raise your Foraging skill level.

If you meet the requirements, the recipe will be sent to you by mail.[/size]
